aws_cloudfront_origin_failover_configure.summary: Configure a valid two-origin CloudFront failover group for this distribution.
steps: Inspect Config.DistributionConfig.Origins and OriginGroups on the exact distribution; identify any missing or duplicate origin IDs and missing or unsupported failover status codes.
Choose a tested secondary origin and status-code criteria with the application owner, then update the reviewed complete distribution configuration without dropping existing behaviors or origins.
Test primary and secondary response paths, read back both origin members and status codes, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Changing a CloudFront distribution can alter production routing and incur secondary-origin costs; review cache behavior targeting the group and rollback before deployment.
The predicate verifies declared origin-group metadata, not live failover availability or origin health.

aws_config_continuous_inventory.summary: Restore continuous, all-supported AWS Config recording in this Region.
steps: Inspect the matching config_recorder.name, recordingGroup.allSupported, default recordingMode.recordingFrequency, every recordingModeOverride frequency and Status.ConfigurationRecordersStatus[].recording.

Review resource type coverage, recording charges, delivery channel and approved exclusions with the account owner, then configure this recorder for all-supported continuous recording and start it if paused.
Confirm the matching recorder reports recording=true, allSupported=true and CONTINUOUS as both default and every override frequency, then recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Continuous all-supported recording can materially increase Config configuration-item and rule-evaluation costs, particularly for ephemeral resources; confirm the owner policy before changing scope.
This predicate checks the recorder declaration and status only; it does not verify delivery-channel health or all account Regions.

aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.summary: Renew or replace this in-use ACM certificate before it becomes unusable.
steps: Inspect Certificate.Certificate.InUseBy, Status, NotAfter and RenewalEligibility against the snapshot time for the exact certificate.
If the certificate is expired, non-ISSUED, or within 30 days and INELIGIBLE, restore its validation/renewal path or replace it through an owner-reviewed certificate and listener migration.
Validate the certificate actually served by each listed consumer and its new expiry, then recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Renewal eligibility is not proof renewal has completed or the new certificate was deployed; inspect consumer endpoints before declaring recovery.
Replacing a certificate can break TLS clients, names or trust chains; stage and test the replacement before cutover.

aws_nist_cloudwatch_alarm_action_enabled.summary: Enable CloudWatch actions and configure an approved state action on this alarm.
steps: Inspect ActionsEnabled and all three AlarmActions, OKActions and InsufficientDataActions lists on the exact metric alarm.
Choose an owner-approved SNS, Auto Scaling or other supported target and state transition, then configure its action and enable actions without discarding existing destinations.
Trigger or simulate an approved alarm transition, confirm delivery, read back the switch and action lists, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Alarm actions can invoke scaling or automation with cost and availability impact; review the selected action and test it safely.
The predicate verifies a configured action and enabled switch, not that the destination is healthy or receives notifications.

aws_config_recorder_all_supported_resour.summary: Expand this Config recorder to all supported resource types without exclusions.
steps: Inspect recordingGroup.allSupported, recordingStrategy.useOnly and exclusionByResourceTypes.resourceTypes[] on the exact recorder.

Review Config recording charges and approved regional scope, then update the owner-reviewed recorder declaration to all-supported recording with no exclusions; start the recorder through its normal change process if needed.
Read back the recording group and exclusions, verify sample resource configuration items and rerun this check.
caveats: Recording all supported resource types can materially increase Config charges and downstream evaluations; review ephemeral workloads before changing policy.
This predicate checks only the recorder's type selection, not whether recording is started, continuous or delivering successfully; aws_config_continuous_inventory covers separate fields.
